skill_name: Describe the application development life cycle.
workflow: The application development life cycle (ADLC) is a process for managing the development of a software application, from conception to deployment. There are generally six distinct phases in the ADLC: planning, analysis, design, implementation and testing, deployment and maintenance. In the planning phase, stakeholders need to evaluate project objectives and decide which type of software should be used.
